svg.title: Smash vs Cover 2
svg.desc: American football play diagram: Smash concept from a spread 2x2 formation against a 4-3 Cover 2 defense. The outside receivers X and Z run 5-yard hitches and the slots H and Y run corner routes, putting each cornerback in a high-low bind under the deep-half safeties; the running back releases to the flat and the offensive line blocks the four-man rush, with the center and right guard double-teaming the nose tackle.

g.text: Spread 2×2 against a 4-3 Cover 2 shell · 2nd & 7, ball on own 35 · college hash marks
